privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy and Terms of Use
privacy_policy.p1_desc: Cervus collects information such as your age, daily consumption, and quit date to track your smoking cessation progress. This data is used solely to provide personalized analysis.
privacy_policy.p2_desc: User data is stored securely on both your local device (Hive) and our secure cloud servers (Firebase). Your data is never shared with third parties.
privacy_policy.p3_desc: The app uses a notification system to send motivational messages. AdMob ads using an anonymous advertising ID may also be displayed to maintain the app.
privacy_policy.p4_desc: Cervus is not a medical advice platform. Health data within the application is for general information purposes only. Please consult a doctor for serious health issues.
privacy_policy.p5_desc: For any questions regarding our privacy policy, you can contact us from within the app.
privacy_policy.footer: By continuing, you agree to the conditions and privacy policy above.

health.title: Recovery Process
health.subtitle: Step by Step Renewal
health.master_purity_desc: Every second, your body's cells are miraculously repairing themselves. Take a deep breath and feel this freshness.
health.goal_0_desc: Blood pressure and heart rate return to normal. Hand and foot temperature increases.
health.goal_1_desc: Carbon monoxide levels in the blood return to normal, oxygen levels increase.
health.goal_2_desc: Body systems relax, and the risk of having a heart attack begins to fall.
health.goal_3_desc: Nerve endings begin to repair themselves. Ability to taste and smell is strengthened.
health.goal_4_desc: Lung capacity increases and airways relax. Shortness of breath decreases.
health.goal_5_desc: Blood circulation and lung functions increase by 30%.
health.goal_6_desc: Coronary heart disease risk drops to half that of a smoker.
health.goal_7_desc: Within 5-15 years, the risk of stroke drops to the level of someone who never smoked.
health.goal_8_desc: The risk of dying from lung cancer is halved compared to someone who still smokes.
health.goal_9_desc: The risk of heart disease falls to the same level as someone who never smoked.
